name: Triumph Street Twin / Speed Twin 900
engine: 900 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: Triumph's modern 900 twin. Several wiring and alternator recalls across the years.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2016 bikes are in recall 16V163 (wiring). 2016-2018 bikes also had a wider wiring recall. 2019-2020 bikes are in recall 20V472 (misrouted harness). 2022 bikes and 2023-on Speed Twin 900s are in recalls 24V785 and 26V078 (alternator wiring).
A-002.reason: Wiring faults can stall the engine or cause a fire. Every fix is free.

recalls.what: Wiring harness may be misrouted and get damaged against the headstock.

recalls.years: 2022 Street models, 2022-2024 Bonnevilles, 2023-2024 Scrambler 900 and Speed Twin 900 (some)
recalls.what: Alternator wiring may short and overheat.
